task: Guide to compare inputs, arrays, missing/null and metadata limits
reference_facts: compare(before,after) requires two Python dictionaries/JSON objects; root arrays rejected.
Array-valued fields are permitted and compared normally.
Absent and null fields compare equal through get().
Files of exactly 1048576 bytes are permitted; larger files rejected.
CLI takes positional before and after paths; compare() takes dictionaries, not file paths.
No endpoint health, full conformance or malicious-behavior proof.

rubric.note: Weights proposed by operator, not counterpart-approved thresholds. Give reasons for defects; no score is assumed.
